description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMessageCommandResponse' which serves as a base for specific message command response implementations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles serialization/deserialization of message payloads, and manages associated thing identifiers and headers.

classes.name: AbstractMessageCommandResponse
classes.description: An abstract base class for message command responses, handling message payloads, headers, and serialization logic.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the associated 'Thing' entity.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message payload associated with this response.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response payload into a JSON object, including thing ID and message details.

methods.name: deserializeMessageFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a 'Message' object from JSON representation, decoding the payload if necessary.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the superclass, thing ID, and message.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality against another object, considering thing ID and message.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if the other object can be considered equal (used in inheritance hierarchy).

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including thing ID and message.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Abstract method for setting Ditto headers, to be implemented by subclasses.
